rationale: Valid patch confidence escalations in the specified independent scope are resolved by complete original raw-diff inspection and exact source pins, native preview/parser/allocation/constants checked against pinned executable, actual-body/wheel/Blender/UV-error controls, transactional rollback controls, full 48-command pass manifest, eight post-stance affected checks including real Blender and freshness, and final exporter regeneration check. Original model scores/distributions are retained unchanged. This is a scoped independent resolution, not whole-bundle approval.

specific_uncertainties_resolved.assembly_correctness_and_test_gap: Eight independently executed current/system Python controls plus actual native Invisivette/Wipeout2/Mustang builds, strict baker acceptance, source pins and native half-suspension proof resolve assembly/fallback/path/pose uncertainty. Current published Mustang matches independently produced in-memory GLB exactly. Full generated corpus strict import and post-fix freshness provide executed coverage.
specific_uncertainties_resolved.assembly_control_spec_and_blast_radius: Synthetic suspension regression is red before correction and green after; actual native proof establishes interpretation instead of arbitrary visual tuning. Independent actual Mini mutates only sampler expression in memory to reproduce prior empty-RGB failure; fixed source yields 8572 triangles unchanged. Five baker tests pass both Python runtimes; all 35 compact FR2 models remain covered. Three actual Blender imports preserve triangles and propagate a 10% stretch in temporary model/catalog directories with all 256 production Redline files retained. Lazy packed images independently verified.
specific_uncertainties_resolved.export_test_gap: Independent changed-fixture controls cover failure with previous directory and initially absent output, exact restoration and success retry; four exporter controls cover non-drawable identity/source pins, tamper, repeat, overlap and unrelated files. Final --check regenerated all128 current GLBs from129 native configurations, matched exact bytes/inventory.
specific_uncertainties_resolved.documentation_blast_radius: Three root docs are scoped append/index/new-note updates with explicit static/fidelity limits and exact final evidence references. Direct index totals and actual native preview evidence support stated conversions/counts; no retail identities or game physics/shader fidelity inferred. Original dealership README remains at root-approved integration pin and is excluded from my independent resolution.
specific_uncertainties_resolved.camera_blast_radius: Root-only camera axis block restores exact frozen integration HTML when reverted; actual extracted setView with Three.js math passes16 game/view cases while preserving other games/top/reset. Native Redline Z-forward supports Front/Side axes; root browser evidence is separate.
